title: Principle of generating critical points of rational functions and Gauss-Fourier conjecture for second-kind zeros
summary: The precise origin of critical points in rational functions remains a longstanding open problem. This paper elucidates the mechanism underlying critical point generation in rational functions. For over two centuries, a conjecture attributed to Gauss and Fourier has remained unresolved: every real zero of $(p^{'}(s)/p(s))^{'}$ is associated with a pair of non-real zeros of the real polynomial $p(s)$.
